title: Prove the fixed dyadic Omega channel profile
head: 90a507b39063cfaebdf92794fcb9d18f358439a6
body:
PR2177 conjectures the complete independent-leaf channel profile at its dyadic Omega cut. This proves a generating-function recurrence for every height and every profile coefficient, including its previously unproved leading counts and fixed-cut mass `(11*4^h - 11*3^h + 1)/6`. The already proved count `c_h=2`, source conjecture, exact word and finite censuses remain credited to Philippe Van Velzen.

The proof uses sign-independent complete-call exit profiles, complementary positive/negative prefix cuts, disjoint factor alphabets, and exact pairing of forward/inverse leaf channels. It closes C2 **at the named cut**. C1/global maximality remains open; no global E_infinity equality, physical rounding necessity, supplier or new kappa is claimed.

Added only `research/leaf-omega-profile/`, with the written proof, exact original PR2177 head and five live source SHA256/Git-blob pins, a full typed receipt, independent forward corroboration and registered replay.

Validation:

- CPython 3.12.14 registered replay passed: 23 literal A/B/Omega profiles through h=8, 16 exact prefix rows, recurrence formulas through h=100, and three effective wrong-order/cut/register controls.
- A separate word generator and forward interpreter passed 682 complete exit columns in both orientations and 646 cut columns through h=4. A matched U/U' pair demonstrates why shared cancelling errors cannot replace independent symbols.
- Seven Git-free optimized CLI test groups passed on Python 3.12.14 and 3.14, including all five source corruptions, authentication-before-execution sentinel, strict numeric receipt types and output preservation.
- Metadata/pins and `git diff --check` passed. Separate Codex proof/code reviews found no actionable issue; no human, Lean, native or hosted-CI verification is claimed.

Started from canonical main `b62dcc58a6beecfcae79627042bf9c48d0e71e6f`; final refresh `5c2ad4fcded5fe44b12d192150bd0ab6af3cc3f3` leaves guidance, selected record and all scientific inputs unchanged. Picker `independent-moment` and required binding baseline are recorded; scope explicitly changed to the named C2 handoff. Full open-PR overlap snapshot: 754 at 18:58 UTC; Discussion snapshot: 1239 at 15:22 UTC, with fresh targeted source-thread/head searches. Later Discussion content and arbitrary code diffs are not covered; no-match is not a novelty certificate.

Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2177#issuecomment-6199634961

Open next question: prove or refute C1 by a structural comparison of arbitrary prefixes with these profiles. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; predecessor credits retained; Apache-2.0.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
